ve: In 1982, Acer (then known in English as Multitech) launched the MicroProfessor-II (MPF-II), built on the 8-bit MOS 6502 with 64KB of RAM; it was Taiwan's first 8-bit home computer.
nz: s1（宏碁官網里程碑頁與 50 週年頁為同一來源；本次核查於 https://www.acer.com/50-years/tw-zh 確認「1982 年 MicroProfessor-II 問世，成為台灣第一台 8 位元家用電腦」）與 s2（科技大觀園刊載之科工館「典藏科技」文章，為另一機構自行撰寫，非轉載通稿）在「1982 年」與「台灣第一台 8 位元（家用）電腦」上一致，核心敘述列為 verified。但：(1) s2 用語「台灣製造的第一台 8 位元電腦產品」範圍過寬，與宏碁自身 1981 年推出的小教授一號（Z80，8 位元單板學習機）相牴觸，且與宏碁史料「台灣第一項八位元電腦產品」措辭高度雷同，疑源自宏碁提供之資料，故僅作佐證，不寫入正文；正文維持「家用電腦」之範圍。(2)「1982 年獲外貿協會多項設計獎」僅見於 s2，屬單一來源，不入正文（外貿協會當時英文名為 CETRA，2004 年起為 TAITRA）。(3) MOS 6502、64KB 由英文維基百科（https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microprofessor_II）與美國電腦歷史博物館藏品（https://www.computerhistory.org/collections/catalog/102692004、102692005：Multitech Industrial Corp.、台灣製、1982）佐證。(4) 天下雜誌與 NOWnews 所稱「全球第一台中文家用電腦」為另一項「第一」，不入本敘述。(5) 維基百科指 MPF-II 為 Apple II 仿製機但非完全相容，避免使用「Apple II 相容」。(6) 本次核查受一次搜尋額度限制，未能逐字核對 s2 引文。
ne: s1 (Acer's milestones page and its 50-years page are one source; my check of https://www.acer.com/50-years/tw-zh confirmed "1982年 MicroProfessor-II 問世，成為台灣第一台 8 位元家用電腦") and s2 (an NSTM "典藏科技" collection article carried on SciTechVista, separately authored by another institution, not a republished wire story) agree on 1982 and "Taiwan's first 8-bit [home] computer", so the core statement is verified. Caveats: (1) s2's wording "the first 8-bit computer product made in Taiwan" is broader than the statement, is contradicted by Acer's own 1981 MicroProfessor-I (a Z80-based, i.e. 8-bit, single-board trainer), and closely mirrors Acer's own history wording ("台灣第一項八位元電腦產品"), so it is likely derived from Acer-supplied material; keep it as corroboration only and keep the published text to the "home computer" scope. (2) The claim that it won several design awards from the external trade council in 1982 appears only in s2 (single source) and is kept out of the published text; the council was CETRA at the time and became TAITRA in 2004. (3) MOS 6502 and 64KB are corroborated by English Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microprofessor_II) and the Computer History Museum catalog (https://www.computerhistory.org/collections/catalog/102692004 and 102692005: Multitech Industrial Corp., made in Taiwan, 1982). (4) CommonWealth and NOWnews's "world's first Chinese-language home computer" is a different "first" and is not used. (5) Wikipedia notes the MPF-II was an Apple II clone but not fully compatible, so avoid "Apple II compatible". (6) Within the one-search budget, s2's quote could not be re-checked verbatim.

zh: 教材：HQ 之下為 PA、EMEA、TWN、AAP、ACCN 五區，TWN 與 AAP 於 2016/2017 年整併為 PAP。
en: Training material: five regions under HQ (PA, EMEA, TWN, AAP, ACCN); TWN and AAP merged into PAP in 2016/2017.
vz: 依宏碁 2024 年公開資料（2024 年第二季法說簡報；富果 2024-12-19 法說會備忘錄），宏碁對外財報將全球營收分為泛美（Pan America）、歐洲中東非洲（EMEA）、泛亞太（Pan Asia Pacific）三區，此點有兩項來源一致。「中國併入泛亞太區」目前僅見於 2Q24 法說簡報「地區營收」頁之註釋（泛亞太涵蓋亞太、日本、台灣、香港及中國大陸；EMEA 涵蓋歐洲、中東與非洲），屬單一（官方）來源，年報或合併財報附註之地區別部門資訊未納入本次查證。富果 2024-12-19 備忘錄載 2024 年第三季占比為泛亞太 51.2%、美洲 25.3%、EMEA 23.5%；惟富果 2025-01-14 備忘錄將美洲與泛亞太數字對調，工商時報（2025-01-14）與數位時代（2024 年）僅佐證泛亞太占比約五成至逾 51%、為集團最大營收區域，美洲與 EMEA 之精確占比仍屬單一來源。宏碁 2024 年第三季財報於 2024 年 11 月上旬公布，該備忘錄為其後之法說會紀錄，非第三季財報法說會本身。本輪未取得 2024／2025 年報之地區劃分表。公開資料亦未見教材所述 PA、EMEA、TWN、AAP、ACCN 五區架構，或 TWN 與 AAP 於 2016／2017 年整併為 PAP 之記載；該等應屬內部服務組織沿革，須以內部文件查證。
ve: Based on Acer's 2024 public materials (2Q24 investor presentation; Fugle investor-conference memo of 19 Dec 2024), Acer's external financial reporting divides revenue into three regions: Pan America, EMEA and Pan Asia Pacific; this point is supported by both sources. That China is reported inside Pan Asia Pacific currently rests on a single (official) source: the footnote on the 2Q24 presentation's revenue-by-geography slide (Pan Asia Pacific includes Asia Pacific, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Mainland China; EMEA includes Europe, the Middle East and Africa); a second source, such as the annual report or the geographic segment note in the consolidated financial statements, is still needed. The Fugle memo of 19 Dec 2024 gives the 3Q24 split as Pan Asia Pacific 51.2%, Americas 25.3%, EMEA 23.5%, but Fugle's 14 Jan 2025 memo swaps the Americas and Pan Asia Pacific figures; Commercial Times (14 Jan 2025) and BusinessNext (2024) corroborate only that Pan Asia Pacific is the largest region at roughly 50% to over 51%, so the exact Americas/EMEA split remains single-sourced. Acer released its 3Q24 results in early November 2024; the memo records a later investor conference, not the 3Q24 results call itself. The regional tables of the 2024/2025 annual reports were not obtained in this round. No public source shows the training material's five-region structure (PA, EMEA, TWN, AAP, ACCN) or a 2016/2017 merger of TWN and AAP into PAP; these appear to be internal service-organization history and must be verified from internal documents.
nz: 限制：(1) 查核時 images.acer.com、blog.fugle.tw、ctee.com.tw 均無法連線，s1 註釋原文與 s2 數字未能由查核者重新核對；s1 註釋為「中國併入泛亞太」之唯一來源，建議另以宏碁年報或合併財報附註「部門資訊—地區別」作第二來源。(2) s2（2024-12-19）為第三季財報公布（2024 年 11 月上旬，科技新報 2024-11-07 報導，第三季營收 726.91 億元）後之法說會備忘錄，非第三季財報法說會本身；其 51.2／25.3／23.5 與富果 2025-01-14 備忘錄（美洲 51.2%、泛亞太 25.3%）互相矛盾，工商時報（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20250114700160-430502，泛亞太逾 51%）與數位時代（https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/80455/acer-market-asia-performance-2024，泛亞營收占比達五成）僅能佐證泛亞太約五成以上。(3) 「2014 年 8 月起整併」之日期未獲證實；數位時代（https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/58112/acer-jason-chen-2020）所載 2014 年三區占比在前輪筆記中為 43%／35%／24%，合計 102%，至少一數字抄錄有誤，須重新核對；news.acer.com 新聞稿之篇名與日期亦未能確認。(4) 教材之五區架構（ACCN 獨立）與 TWN／AAP 於 2016／2017 整併屬內部服務組織沿革，公開資料無從查證，建議教材區分「內部服務組織」與「對外財報區域」。(5) 2024／2025 年報之地區劃分表未取得，宏碁投資人 FAQ 指引參閱每季法說簡報。
ne: Limits: (1) images.acer.com, blog.fugle.tw and ctee.com.tw were unreachable during fact-checking, so the s1 footnote wording and the s2 figures could not be re-verified; the s1 footnote is the only source for 'China inside Pan Asia Pacific', and a second source should be sought in Acer's annual report or the geographic segment note of the consolidated financial statements. (2) s2 (19 Dec 2024) is a memo of an investor conference held after the 3Q24 results release (early November 2024; TechNews 7 Nov 2024, 3Q24 revenue NT$72.69bn), not the 3Q24 results call itself; its 51.2/25.3/23.5 split contradicts Fugle's 14 Jan 2025 memo (Americas 51.2%, PAP 25.3%); Commercial Times (https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20250114700160-430502, PAP above 51%) and BusinessNext (https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/80455/acer-market-asia-performance-2024, Pan Asia about 50% of revenue) corroborate only that PAP is roughly half or more. (3) The 'from August 2014' date is unconfirmed; the 2014 split noted from BusinessNext (https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/58112/acer-jason-chen-2020) as 43%/35%/24% sums to 102%, so at least one figure is mis-transcribed and must be re-checked; the news.acer.com release and its date remain unidentified. (4) The five-region structure (ACCN separate) and the 2016/2017 TWN/AAP merger are internal service-organization history not found in public sources; the material should distinguish internal service regions from external financial-reporting regions. (5) The 2024/2025 annual-report regional tables were not obtained; Acer's investor FAQ points to the quarterly presentations.

vz: 2007年9月1日，原上市公司明基電通（股票代號2352）完成品牌與代工事業分割：原上市主體更名為佳世達科技（Qisda Corporation），保留台灣證券交易所上市地位並專注ODM／代工製造業務；品牌事業分割至新設之全資子公司明基電通（BenQ Corporation），沿用BenQ品牌。
ve: On 1 September 2007 the listed company BenQ Corp. (TWSE: 2352) completed the separation of its brand and contract-manufacturing businesses: the listed entity was renamed Qisda Corporation, retaining the TWSE listing and focusing on ODM/contract manufacturing, while the brand business was spun off into a newly established, wholly owned subsidiary, BenQ Corporation, which kept the BenQ brand name.
nz: 無實質衝突。分割生效日現有兩個獨立來源：Taipei Times 2007-09-04 報導稱分割於前一個週六完成（即2007-09-01）；明基電通官方公告（mics.ru 轉載）稱新中英文名稱自2007年9月1日生效。維基百科衍生頁面稱新明基電通於2007-09-03「開始營運」，應為生效日（週六）後首個營業日，非真正衝突。其他佐證：Taipei Times 2007-04-30（董事長李焜耀預告9月分割品牌事業）、PCWorld/IDG（abcnews 轉載）、自由時報（2007年明基電通分割並更名佳世達科技，BenQ品牌成為子公司）、今周刊（2007年正式更名佳世達，明基電通負責品牌業務成為子公司）。限制：搜尋摘要未逐句標註來源URL，s2 引文為搜尋摘要文字而非原文逐字；3次搜尋內未找到公開資訊觀測站／證交所正式公告或年報原文。
ne: No substantive conflict. The effective date now has two independent sources: Taipei Times 2007-09-04 reports the split was completed the previous Saturday (= 1 Sep 2007); BenQ's own announcement (republished on mics.ru) states the new Chinese and English names take effect on 1 September 2007. A Wikipedia-derived page says the new BenQ 'began operating' on 3 Sep 2007, which is the first business day after the Saturday effective date, not a true conflict. Further corroboration: Taipei Times 2007-04-30 (chairman K.Y. Lee announced the brand business would be spun off in September), PCWorld/IDG via abcnews, Liberty Times (2007 restructuring, rename to Qisda Corporation, BenQ brand became a subsidiary) and Business Today (formally renamed Qisda in 2007, BenQ Corp. handles the brand business as a subsidiary). Limits: the search summaries did not attribute every sentence to a specific URL, so the s2 quote is the summarised snippet rather than verbatim text; no MOPS/TWSE filing or annual-report text surfaced within the 3-search budget.

zh: 2022 年 7 月已有 7 家上市櫃子公司；2024 年 11 月第 11 家（博瑞達應材興櫃）；2025 年 11 月第 16 家（Opticon）。
en: Seven listed by July 2022; the 11th in November 2024 (BRD Materials); the 16th in November 2025 (Opticon).
vz: 2024年11月29日，展碁國際子公司博瑞達應材（6972）登錄興櫃，財訊報導稱其為宏碁集團在台灣第11家掛牌子公司；2025年11月28日，宏碁宣布與Esquarre Vision Limited共同投資日本自動辨識及資料擷取（AIDC）解決方案供應商OPTOELECTRONICS（品牌Opticon），宏碁出資15.9億日圓取得約38%股權，依宏碁公告，交易預計2026年初完成後，Opticon將成為集團第16家上市櫃子公司。
ve: On 29 November 2024, BRD Materials (6972), a subsidiary of Weblink International, was registered on the TPEx Emerging Stock Board; Wealth Magazine (財訊) described it as the Acer Group's 11th subsidiary listed in Taiwan. On 28 November 2025, Acer announced that it and Esquarre Vision Limited would invest in OPTOELECTRONICS (brand Opticon), a Japanese automatic identification and data capture (AIDC) solutions supplier, with Acer paying JPY1.59 billion for about 38%; according to Acer's announcement, once the transaction closes (expected in early 2026) Opticon will become the group's 16th listed subsidiary.
nz: （1）來源獨立性：s1鉅亨網與s2中央社均轉述宏碁2025年11月28日新聞稿，非獨立來源；且s2引文為搜尋摘要彙整而非中央社原文，中央社標題亦無「第16家」字樣，故「第16家」實僅宏碁自述（陳俊聖），網站須標明「依宏碁公告」並說明為交易完成後之預期（預計2026年初）。（2）「2022年7月已有7家上市櫃子公司」：研究者3次檢索與本次1次複核均查無來源，應自網站刪除，或改引宏碁年報／公告並附出處。本次複核另發現計數基準不一：2023年1月報導稱集團「上市櫃、興櫃、公開發行累計10家」，倚天酷碁（2432）遲至2023年5月才於創新板掛牌，宏碁資訊（6811）2022年8月才由興櫃轉上櫃（參見 https://ctee.com.tw/news/tech/784034.html 、https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/76127/acer-acergadget-ipo-market 、https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/75452/acer-gadget-2432 ），「7家」是否含興櫃／公開發行公司無法判定。（3）「第11家」僅見財訊（限定「在台灣掛牌」，疑為LINE Today轉載），數位時代同期稱「12家IPO子公司」，屬單一來源且有衝突；修正句已補回「在台灣」限定語並標明出處。登錄興櫃日期採中央社與鉅亨網之11月29日（財訊作11月28日）。（4）狀態維持 conflict；各媒體對集團掛牌家數（11、12、16、17）基準混用，網站引用任何家數時均應註明計數基準與出處。
ne: (1) Independence: s1 (cnyes) and s2 (CNA) both relay Acer's 28 Nov 2025 press release and are not independent; s2's snippet is a search-summary aggregation rather than CNA's text, and the CNA headline does not mention "16th", so the "16th" figure rests solely on Acer's own statement (chairman Jason Chen). The site must attribute it to Acer's announcement and present it as a post-closing expectation (closing expected early 2026). (2) "Seven listed subsidiaries by July 2022": unsourced after the researcher's three searches and this one re-check; delete it from the site or replace it with a figure cited from Acer's annual report/announcements. The re-check also shows the counting bases differ: a January 2023 report counts 10 group companies that are listed, emerging-board or publicly issued; Acer Gadget (2432) was not listed until May 2023 on the TWSE Innovation Board; Acer e-Enabling (6811) moved from emerging to TPEx only in August 2022 (see https://ctee.com.tw/news/tech/784034.html , https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/76127/acer-acergadget-ipo-market , https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/75452/acer-gadget-2432 ). Whether "7" includes emerging-board/publicly-issued companies cannot be determined. (3) "11th" appears only in Wealth Magazine (qualified as "listed in Taiwan", probably via the LINE Today republication), while Business Next's contemporaneous feature counts "12 IPO subsidiaries": single-sourced and conflicting. The corrected text restores the "in Taiwan" qualifier and attributes the count. The registration date follows CNA and cnyes (29 Nov 2024; Wealth Magazine says 28 Nov). (4) Status stays "conflict"; media counts of the group's listed companies (11, 12, 16, 17) mix bases, so any count on the site should state its basis and source.

zh: 展碁創立於 1997 年。
en: Weblink was founded in 1997.
vz: 展碁國際股份有限公司（6776；統一編號 20773257）依經濟部公司登記資料及公司財報沿革，於 1977 年 12 月 22 日（民國 66 年）奉經濟部核准設立；惟天下雜誌、科技新報等媒體及 Yahoo Finance 等金融資料庫均以 1997 年為其成立年份，科技新報並指展碁為宏碁於 1997 年設立的 3C 代理事業。兩個年份所指不同：1977 年為法人登記日期，1997 年為展碁通路事業的起始年。公司為宏碁集團子公司，股票於 2021 年 3 月 31 日在臺灣證券交易所上市。
ve: Weblink International Inc. (6776; Unified Business No. 20773257) was approved for incorporation by the Ministry of Economic Affairs on 22 December 1977 according to the MOEA company registry and the company's own corporate-history disclosure. However, media reports (CommonWealth Magazine, TechNews) and financial-data profiles (Yahoo Finance) give 1997 as its founding year, with TechNews describing Weblink as the 3C distribution business that Acer set up in 1997. The two dates refer to different things: 1977 is the legal entity's registration date, while 1997 marks the start of Weblink's distribution business. The company is an Acer Group subsidiary and was listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange on 31 March 2021.
nz: 查核結果：(1) s1（經濟部商工登記鏡像，TechNews 公司資料庫）與 s2（公司財報「公司沿革」文字經 nStock 轉載）來源鏈不同，可視為獨立，且均支持 1977 年 12 月 22 日核准設立；s2 另支持 2021 年 3 月 31 日上市。(2) vz 中「為宏碁集團子公司」與「Yahoo Finance 等金融資料庫記為 1997 年」兩點並非出自 s1/s2 引文，僅見於研究備註（MONEY LINK、Yahoo Finance）。(3) 研究備註稱 1997 年僅見於金融資料庫、可能為單一數據供應商或 1977 之誤植、未見公司或媒體資料支持，此說法有誤：一次檢索即顯示天下雜誌（cw.com.tw/article/5136950）與科技新報（finance.technews.tw/2021/03/12/weblink-the-transformed-company/）均以 1997 年為展碁成立年份，科技新報明指展碁為宏碁於 1997 年設立的 3C 代理事業；遠見（gvm.com.tw/article/95934，轉載報導）則寫 1977 年，與登記資料一致。故 1997 年並非誤植，而是展碁通路事業的起始年，1977 年為法人登記日期，原始陳述「創立於 1997 年（登記資料顯示 1977 年 12 月）」的並列寫法基本正確；研究建議「網站以 1977 年為準」不宜採納。(4) 狀態維持 conflict：兩個年份各有獨立來源，但「1997 年為事業起始、法人沿用 1977 年登記」的調和說法尚未以公司年報「公司沿革」等一手文件（例如是否於 1997 年更名或轉型）證實，補查後方可升為 verified。網站建議寫法：以 1997 年為展碁成立年份，並註明法人登記日期為 1977 年 12 月 22 日。
ne: Check results: (1) s1 (MOEA registry mirror on the TechNews company database) and s2 (the company's own financial-statement corporate-history wording republished by nStock) come from different source chains and can be treated as independent; both support incorporation approved on 22 December 1977, and s2 also supports the TWSE listing on 31 March 2021. (2) The vz clauses "Acer Group subsidiary" and "Yahoo Finance and other financial databases give 1997" are not in the s1/s2 quotes; they appear only in the research notes (MONEY LINK, Yahoo Finance). (3) The notes' claim that 1997 appears only in financial-data profiles, probably from a single upstream vendor or as a transposition of 1977, with no company or media support, is wrong: a single search shows CommonWealth Magazine (cw.com.tw/article/5136950) and TechNews (finance.technews.tw/2021/03/12/weblink-the-transformed-company/) both giving 1997 as Weblink's founding year, with TechNews explicitly describing Weblink as the 3C distribution business Acer set up in 1997; Global Views (gvm.com.tw/article/95934, a republished report) writes 1977, consistent with the registry. So 1997 is not a typo but the start of the Weblink distribution business, while 1977 is the legal entity's registration date; the original hedged statement "founded in 1997 (registry shows December 1977)" was essentially correct, and the researcher's recommendation to use only 1977 on the site should not be adopted. (4) Status remains "conflict": each year has independent support, but the reconciliation (1997 = business start, legal entity carried over from a 1977 registration, e.g. via a 1997 rename or repurposing) has not yet been confirmed from a primary document such as the annual report's corporate-history section; it can be upgraded to verified once that is checked. Suggested site wording: give 1997 as Weblink's founding year and note the legal registration date of 22 December 1977.

zh: 2014 年 7 月起為 Acer 台灣總代理之一（與聯強同時）。
en: One of Acer's Taiwan general agents since July 2014 (alongside Synnex).
vz: 宏碁台灣區營運總部於 2014 年 7 月 3 日正式宣布通路新佈局，與聯強國際（Synnex）及展碁國際（Weblink）結盟，兩者共同成為宏碁台灣區全線產品總代理，首期簽訂一年期合約；據 Taipei Times 報導，兩家代理商已自 2014 年 7 月 1 日起開始銷售宏碁桌上型電腦、筆記型電腦、平板、智慧型手機、顯示器及伺服器等全線產品。依宏碁新聞稿，展碁負責銷售宏碁全產品線並扮演行銷、推廣、服務、物流與資金的平台角色；聯強則為首度在台灣與宏碁合作。展碁國際為宏碁集團旗下通路代理商，其後持續代理宏碁產品（2016 年 9 月 Taipei Times 報導其當時在台代理宏碁筆記型電腦與桌上型電腦）。
ve: On 3 July 2014 Acer's Taiwan operations headquarters formally announced a new channel structure, partnering with Synnex Technology and Weblink International, which jointly became Acer's full-line general agents (總代理) for Taiwan under initial one-year contracts; according to the Taipei Times, the two distributors had begun selling Acer's full line (desktops, notebooks, tablets, smartphones, monitors and servers) on 1 July 2014. Per Acer's press release, Weblink sells the full Acer product line and serves as the marketing, promotion, service, logistics and financing platform, while this was Synnex's first cooperation with Acer in Taiwan. Weblink, an Acer-group channel distributor, has continued to distribute Acer products since (a Taipei Times report of September 2016 said it then handled Acer notebooks and desktops in Taiwan).
nz: 限制與修正：(1) CTIMES、DIGITIMES 中文、數位時代、經理人、電腦DIY 所刊皆為同一篇宏碁新聞稿，僅計一個來源（s1）。s2 為 Taipei Times 自行採訪報導（自由時報網站以《TAIPEI TIMES 焦點》轉載，該 LTN 網址經查證確實存在），內容含新聞稿未載之資訊（宏碁預估第三季台灣營收季增四成、年增一成；一年期合約；大中華區總裁 Tony Huang 談話；兩家代理商於週二即 2014 年 7 月 1 日開始銷售），與 s1 相互獨立；DIGITIMES 英文版 2014-07-04 報導（https://digitimes.com/tag/weblink/0021776.html）為第三佐證，「verified」成立。(2) 求真百科所記之 7 月 1 日與新聞稿之 7 月 3 日並非出入：7 月 1 日為開始銷售日，7 月 3 日為正式宣布日。(3) 首期合約為一年期；2016-09-14 Taipei Times（https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/biz/archives/2016/09/14/2003655085）報導展碁當時在台代理宏碁筆電與桌機，且宏碁考慮將展碁併入台灣分公司或擴大其代理權，故「全線產品總代理」身分是否延續至今未獲直接證實，僅能證實代理關係持續。(4) 已自陳述中移除原研究未附來源之資訊（展碁 2020-03-25 登錄興櫃、2021-03-31 掛牌上市、股票代號 6776，以及天下雜誌所稱宏碁業務約佔展碁營收四分之一至三分之一）；該等資訊與 2014 年總代理之陳述無關，若其他項目需引用請另行查證。(5) 附帶發現：MoneyDJ 摘要稱展碁成立於 1977 年，天下雜誌與其他來源稱 1997 年，供其他項目參考。
ne: Limits and corrections: (1) CTIMES, Digitimes (Chinese), Bnext, Manager Today and ComputerDIY all carry the same Acer press release and count as one source (s1). s2 is the Taipei Times' own reporting (reposted on the Liberty Times site as 《TAIPEI TIMES 焦點》; the LTN URL was confirmed to exist) and contains material absent from the press release (Acer's forecast of Q3 Taiwan sales +40% QoQ / +10% YoY, the one-year contracts, remarks by Greater China president Tony Huang, and that the two distributors began selling on Tuesday 1 July 2014), so it is independent of s1; Digitimes' English report of 4 July 2014 (https://digitimes.com/tag/weblink/0021776.html) is a third corroboration, and 'verified' stands. (2) Factpedia's 1 July versus the press release's 3 July is not a discrepancy: sales began on 1 July and the formal announcement came on 3 July. (3) The initial contracts were one-year; a Taipei Times report of 14 Sept 2016 (https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/biz/archives/2016/09/14/2003655085) said Weblink then handled Acer notebooks and desktops in Taiwan and that Acer was considering folding Weblink into its Taiwan branch or widening its rights, so continuation of 'full-line general agent' status to the present is not directly confirmed, only the continued agency relationship. (4) Removed from the statement because the research cited no source for them and they are irrelevant to the 2014 agency claim: Weblink's Emerging Stock Board registration (25 March 2020), TWSE listing (31 March 2021, ticker 6776) and CommonWealth Magazine's estimate that Acer business is one-quarter to one-third of Weblink's revenue; re-verify before using them elsewhere. (5) Side finding: a MoneyDJ summary gives Weblink's founding as 1977 while CommonWealth Magazine and others say 1997, for reference on other items.

zh: 董事長為陳俊聖。
en: Chaired by Jason Chen.
vz: 展碁國際（股票代號 6776）現任董事長為林佳璋，並兼任總經理。2026年5月26日（民國115年5月26日）股東常會全面改選董事後，新任董事會於同日推選總經理林佳璋接任董事長，接替因任期屆滿而卸任董事長職務的陳俊聖（Jason Chen）。經濟部商工登記之公司代表人亦已更新為林佳璋（據商工登記資料，最後核准變更日期為 2026-06-04）。「陳俊聖為展碁國際董事長」僅適用於 2026 年 5 月 26 日以前。
ve: Weblink International (stock code 6776) is currently chaired by 林佳璋, who also serves as President. Following the full board re-election at the annual general meeting on 26 May 2026, the new board elected President 林佳璋 as chairman the same day, succeeding Jason Chen (陳俊聖), whose term as chairman had expired. The MOEA company registry now also lists 林佳璋 as the company's representative (per registry data, last approved change 2026-06-04). "Jason Chen is chairman of Weblink" is accurate only for the period before 26 May 2026.
nz: 兩項來源（工商時報 2026-05-27 報導；公開資訊觀測站重大訊息經 Yahoo 股市轉載，2026-05-26）出處與性質不同、內容一致：2026-05-26 股東會全面改選後，董事會同日推選總經理林佳璋為董事長，異動原因為原董事長陳俊聖任期屆滿。原「陳俊聖為董事長」與「登記代表人為林佳璋」並非矛盾，而是時間差。複核搜尋補充：Yahoo 股市最新基本資料已將董事長與總經理均列為林佳璋（研究者所引 2026/02/10 版仍列陳俊聖，屬改選前資料）；台灣公司網（twincn）較新版本亦顯示林佳璋任董事長、陳俊聖為董事；鉅亨網、Win 投資、opengovtw 等彙整網站仍顯示陳俊聖為董事長，屬未更新之舊資料，應以公開資訊觀測站公告為準。修正事項：(1) 原稿「櫃買 6776」存疑，Yahoo 股市代號為 6776.TW（.TW 為上市、.TWO 為上櫃），改為中性之「股票代號 6776」；(2) 「宏碁股份有限公司法人代表」一語未見於所引用之兩項來源摘錄，已刪除；(3) s2 引文為搜尋摘要之改寫，非公告原文逐字引用。限制：研究者與複核者均未直接開啟公開資訊觀測站原始公告；商工登記「最後核准變更日期 2026-06-04」來自 info.technews.tw 轉載，未經獨立驗證。
ne: The two sources (Commercial Times report, 2026-05-27; MOPS material announcement republished by Yahoo Stock, 2026-05-26) differ in publisher and type and agree: after the full board re-election at the 26 May 2026 AGM, the board elected President 林佳璋 as chairman the same day, the stated reason being the expiry of former chairman Jason Chen's term. The apparent contradiction (Jason Chen as chairman vs. 林佳璋 as registry representative) is a timing difference. Fact-check search added: Yahoo Stock's current profile now lists 林佳璋 as both Chairman and President (the researcher's 2026/02/10 snapshot still showed Jason Chen, i.e. pre-election data); a newer twincn registry mirror shows 林佳璋 as chairman with 陳俊聖 as a director; Anue (cnyes), Win投資 and opengovtw still show Jason Chen as chairman but are stale; the MOPS filing is authoritative. Corrections: (1) "TPEx: 6776" is doubtful - Yahoo's ticker is 6776.TW (.TW denotes TWSE main board, .TWO denotes TPEx), so the statement now says "stock code 6776" without naming the exchange; (2) "Acer Inc.'s corporate representative director" appears in neither quoted source excerpt and was removed as unsupported; (3) the s2 "quote" is a search-snippet paraphrase, not verbatim MOPS text. Limitations: neither the researcher nor the checker opened the original MOPS announcement; the registry date 2026-06-04 comes from an info.technews.tw mirror and is unverified.

zh: 宏碁持股約 57%；2022 年 1 月買回宏碁雲架構。
en: About 57% owned by Acer; bought back Acer eDC in January 2022.
vz: 宏碁為安碁資訊（6690）之控制性法人股東，依安碁資訊年報揭露持有15,561,992股、持股比率51.87%（2026年8月董監持股申報仍約51.9%）。安碁資訊於2021年11月經董事會決議，以新台幣4億7,574萬7,145元向母公司宏碁買回宏碁雲架構服務股份有限公司（原自安碁資訊分割之機房、雲端維運及軟體銷售業務）100%股權，並依公司沿革於2022年1月完成取得。
ve: Acer is the controlling corporate shareholder of Acer Cyber Security Inc. (ACSI, TPEx 6690), holding 15,561,992 shares, or 51.87%, per ACSI's annual report (director-holding filings as of August 2026 still show about 51.9%). (宏碁雲架構服務, the data-center, cloud-operations and software-sales business previously split off from ACSI) for NT$475,747,145; according to ACSI's corporate history, the acquisition was completed in January 2022.
nz: 狀態由 verified 下修為 single。理由：s1（FinLab 引用安碁年報）僅支持持股51.87%，s2（安碁官網沿革）僅支持2022年1月取得股權，兩者並非對同一事實的相互印證；FinLab、Goodinfo、Yahoo股市、富聯網皆轉載安碁資訊向主管機關申報之資料（年報、董監持股），官網亦屬公司自行揭露，實為單一來源脈絡。2022年1月完成交割僅有官網沿革及 uc913 佐證，工商時報（2021-11-04）與鉅亨網僅稱「預計」2022年1月完成，未找到公開資訊觀測站之完成公告。查核者一次搜尋：Goodinfo（https://goodinfo.tw/tw/StockDetail.asp?STOCK_ID=6690）、富聯網（https://money-link.com.tw/TWStock/StockBasic.aspx?TWMId=Basic_drt01&SymId=6690）、Yahoo股市（https://tw.stock.yahoo.com/quote/6690.TWO/profile）、FinLab（https://finlab.finance/stocks/6690）均為51.87%／51.9%，無任何來源支持「約57%」；另查得安碁資訊2022年6月辦理現金增資發行新股（https://stockluckydraw.com/stock/2022/20220609001.php），可解釋持股比率自2021年約64.5%（Goodinfo）、2022年63.63%（PTT）、59.88%（uc913、vocus，未註明日期）逐步稀釋至51.87%；「約57%」至多為過時之中間值，原文應改為51.87%並註明資料時點。研究者 vz 中「已發行股數29,999,720股」及「2017年自安碁資訊分割」未見於任何引用片段，已自正文移除，未列入正文；「2024年報」究指會計年度2023或2024未能確定。可作為第二來源之資料：(1) 公開資訊觀測站2022年1月安碁資訊取得宏碁雲架構服務100%股權之重大訊息，或安碁2022年年報之相關說明；(2) 宏碁年報轉投資事業明細或安碁年報「主要股東名單」原文，作為持股比率之第二獨立申報主體。
ne: Status lowered from verified to single. s1 (FinLab citing ACSI's annual report) supports only the 51.87% holding; s2 (ACSI's corporate-history page) supports only the January-2022 acquisition — they do not corroborate the same fact. FinLab, Goodinfo, Yahoo Stock and money-link all republish ACSI's regulatory filings (annual report, director-holding reports), and the company website is likewise self-disclosure, so each half of the statement rests on a single provenance. The January-2022 completion is attested only by the company history page and uc913; Commercial Times (2021-11-04) and cnyes say closing was "expected" in January 2022, and no MOPS completion announcement was found. The checker's single search confirmed 51.87%/51.9% on Goodinfo (https://goodinfo.tw/tw/StockDetail.asp?STOCK_ID=6690), money-link (https://money-link.com.tw/TWStock/StockBasic.aspx?TWMId=Basic_drt01&SymId=6690), Yahoo Stock (https://tw.stock.yahoo.com/quote/6690.TWO/profile) and FinLab (https://finlab.finance/stocks/6690); no source supports "about 57%". A June-2022 cash capital increase by ACSI (https://stockluckydraw.com/stock/2022/20220609001.php) explains the dilution from about 64.5% (Goodinfo, 2021) and 63.63% (PTT, 2022) via 59.88% (uc913/vocus, undated) to 51.87% — "57%" is at best an outdated interim value, so the statement should read 51.87% with an as-of date. The researcher's vz also asserted "29,999,720 shares outstanding" and a "2017" spin-off year, neither of which appears in any quoted snippet; both were removed from the statement for lack of a source. Whether "2024 annual report" means FY2023 or FY2024 remains unresolved. To reach verified: (1) the MOPS material-information notice (January 2022) or ACSI's 2022 annual report confirming completion of the eDC acquisition; (2) Acer's annual-report list of investee companies or ACSI's annual-report "major shareholders" table as a second, independently filed provenance for the holding.

nz: 狀態降為 conflict。(1) s1（建碁官網）與 s2（宏碁2017年年報）雖非同一則新聞稿轉載，但同屬宏碁集團文件（建碁為宏碁子公司），且兩者只在「2017年11月宏碁透過私募將建碁重新納入集團」一點重疊；s2 完全未提及「第一家內部創業」，該說法僅見於建碁官網自述及中文維基（內容與官網相同），屬單一來源，故改寫為「依建碁官方說明」。(2) 40.55%、28,970,000股及「2000年8月上櫃」均不在 s1/s2 引文中；40.55% 來自建碁主要股東名單（與 s1 同一發布者），「2000年8月上櫃」無引文支持，已刪除。(3) 持股比例各來源互相矛盾：宏碁2017年年報載董事會決議「認購後持股51%」；工商時報2017-11-10（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20171110700020-439901）報導私募總額4.2億元、預估完成後持股約48%；中時2018-01-31（https://www.chinatimes.com/realtimenews/20180131001570-260511）報導宏碁「持股比逾4成」正式入主建碁、陳俊聖兼任董事長。4.2億元÷28,970,000股≈每股14.5元，顯示宏碁目前持有的28,970,000股即為當年私募認購股數，研究者所稱「由51%降至40.55%」並無證據；51%應為董事會決議階段之預計數，原敘述「2017年持股40.55%」反而可能較接近事實，但私募完成時點的精確比例仍須以公開資訊觀測站之建碁／宏碁重大訊息或2018年年報核對後再寫入。
ne: Status lowered to conflict. (1) s1 (AOpen official site) and s2 (Acer 2017 annual report) are not a republished wire story, but both are Acer-group documents (AOpen is Acer's subsidiary) and overlap only on "Nov 2017 private placement brought AOpen back into the Acer group"; s2 never mentions "first internal venture", which appears only in AOpen's self-description and zh-Wikipedia (same wording), so it is single-sourced and is now attributed ("by its own account"). (2) 40.55%, 28,970,000 shares and "TPEx listing Aug 2000" are absent from both quoted snippets; 40.55% comes from AOpen's major-shareholder list (same publisher as s1), and "Aug 2000 TPEx" has no quoted support and was dropped. (3) The stake figure conflicts across sources: Acer's 2017 AR gives 51% at board-resolution stage; 工商時報 2017-11-10 (https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20171110700020-439901) reported a NT$420M placement with an estimated ~48% stake; 中時 2018-01-31 (https://www.chinatimes.com/realtimenews/20180131001570-260511) reported Acer "holding over 40%" when it formally took over AOpen with Jason Chen as chairman. NT$420M ÷ 28,970,000 shares ≈ NT$14.5/share, so Acer's current 28,970,000 shares are exactly the 2017 placement shares; there is no evidence of a later "drop from 51% to 40.55%", and the original "2017 … 40.55%" may be closer to correct than the researcher's correction. The exact ratio at completion should be confirmed from MOPS filings or Acer's/AOpen's 2018 annual reports before being stated.

nz: s1為工商時報搜尋摘要而非原文；s2為Yahoo轉載、原始媒體未確認，兩者各只覆蓋聲明的一部分（s1僅伺服器、s2僅三大領域概述與非PC占比）。伺服器與非PC占比部分另有中時旺得富、自由時報、聯合報、TechNews等獨立報導佐證（非PC 2025年25%→29%；德州與大溪新廠以伺服器為主；2027年伺服器營收占比目標上看40%、絕大多數為AI伺服器）。研究者原文的「AI伺服器營收占比30%至40%」與引用標題「伺服器營收占比挑戰40%」不符，已改正；北醫大MOU「5月4日」無引文佐證（兩則報導皆為2026-05-05），改為「2026年5月」；波蘭廠350萬台ECU、Czeladź等細節僅見於未引文的鉅亨網連結，已改為保守敘述。車用與智慧醫療細節在JSON內仍屬單一來源，故狀態降為single。

zh: 2009 年上半年為 Acer 最大代工廠（約 45%）；2014 年約四成；2008 年 Aspire One 委由仁寶與緯創。
en: Acer's largest ODM in H1 2009 (about 45%); about 40% of 2014 orders; 2009 Aspire One assigned to Compal and Wistron.
vz: 2008年10月，DigiTimes 引述筆電業界消息報導，Acer 計畫將 2009 年約 1,500 萬台 Aspire One 小筆電訂單轉由仁寶與緯創代工，廣達出局；2009年1月另有報導（DigiTimes 引蘋果日報）指 Acer 10 吋 Aspire One 將由仁寶製造。2009年7月28日工商時報報導，仁寶被視為宏碁第一階段筆電代工釋單的最大贏家，有機會取得約 35% 的訂單量。（原敘述中「2009 年上半年仁寶為 Acer 最大代工廠約 45%」及「2014 年取得約四成 Acer 15 吋機種訂單」兩項數字，本次未找到任何公開來源佐證。）
ve: In October 2008 DigiTimes reported, citing notebook industry sources, that Acer planned to outsource about 15 million Aspire One netbook orders for 2009 to Compal and Wistron, dropping Quanta; a January 2009 report (Apple Daily via DigiTimes) said Acer's 10-inch Aspire One would be made by Compal. On 28 July 2009 the Commercial Times (工商時報) reported that Compal was regarded as the biggest winner of Acer's first-stage notebook order allocation, with a chance to take about 35% of the volume. (The original figures "about 45% / largest ODM in H1 2009" and "about 40% of Acer's 2014 orders, 15-inch models" were not corroborated by any public source found.)
nz: 1) 「2009年上半年仁寶為 Acer 最大筆電代工廠（約45%）」：未找到任何來源；最接近的數字為工商時報 2009-07-28 報導仁寶有機會拿下宏碁第一階段釋單約 35%，且屬釋單預估而非上半年實績，與原敘述的 45% 不符（兩個值：原敘述 45% vs. 工商時報 35%）。工商時報 2009-07-10（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20090710700019-439901）另載仁寶 2009 上半年出貨約 1,410 萬台、成長主要來自宏碁小筆電，但未給 Acer 訂單占比；維基百科載仁寶 2009 年全球筆電市占近 23%（全年、全市場口徑）。2) 「2014 年取得約四成 Acer 筆電訂單（15吋機種）」：完全未找到來源；工商時報 2013-12-30（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20131230700064-439901）僅載仁寶 2014 年筆電出貨目標約 4,000 萬台（年增約 5%）。3) Aspire One 部分：DigiTimes 2008-10-15/16 為業界消息、非 Acer 官方公告；Wikipedia「Quanta Computer」條目（https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quanta_Computer）亦載 2008 年 10 月 Acer 將 1,500 萬台 Aspire One 外包仁寶、廣達出局，但僅提仁寶、未提緯創，且屬三手來源；DigiTimes 2009-01-14（https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20090114PB204.html）引蘋果日報稱 10 吋 Aspire One 由仁寶製造、售價約 US$399。因此僅 Aspire One 一項有單一自主報導來源加旁證，s1 與 s2 各支持敘述的不同部分，非同一事實的兩個獨立來源，故維持 single。3 次搜尋額度已用盡，無法再追查 2014 年與 45% 的原始出處（建議查 2014 年仁寶法說會或經濟日報／工商時報當年報導）。
ne: 1) "Compal was Acer's largest notebook ODM in H1 2009 (about 45%)": no source found. The closest figure is Commercial Times 2009-07-28 saying Compal could take about 35% of Acer's first-stage order release, which is a projection rather than an H1 2009 actual and does not match 45% (statement 45% vs. Commercial Times 35%). Commercial Times 2009-07-10 (https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20090710700019-439901) gives Compal H1 2009 shipments of about 14.1M units driven mainly by Acer netbooks, but no Acer order share; Wikipedia gives Compal's 2009 global notebook share as about 23% (full-year, whole-market basis). 2) "About 40% of Acer's 2014 notebook orders (15-inch)": nothing found; Commercial Times 2013-12-30 (https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20131230700064-439901) only gives Compal's 2014 notebook shipment target of about 40M units (+5%). 3) Aspire One portion: the DigiTimes 2008-10-15/16 report is based on industry sources, not an Acer announcement; the Wikipedia "Quanta Computer" article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quanta_Computer) also says that in October 2008 Acer phased Quanta out and outsourced 15M Aspire One units to Compal, but names only Compal, not Wistron, and is a tertiary source; DigiTimes 2009-01-14 (https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20090114PB204.html), citing Apple Daily, says the 10-inch Aspire One would be made by Compal at about US$399. So only the Aspire One claim rests on one outlet's own reporting plus corroboration; s1 and s2 support different parts of the statement rather than being two independent sources for the same fact, hence "single". The 3-search budget is exhausted, so the origin of the 45% and 2014/40% figures could not be traced (suggest checking Compal's 2014 investor conference materials or Economic Daily/Commercial Times reports from that year).

en: Acer's 2009 and 2014 ODM allocation.
vz: 宏碁筆電代工分配僅見於媒體報導，各時期口徑不一。工商時報 2009 年 7 月 28 日報導：宏碁釋出第一階段約 2,000 萬台筆電代工訂單，仁寶為最大贏家、取得逾三成（最高可達 35%），廣達與緯創各接近三成，英業達約一成；本次查證未能找到「仁寶約 45%、緯創 26–28%」之出處。工商時報 2012 年 7 月 26 日報導：宏碁對仁寶的依賴度已降至 40–45%，並砍單約 500 萬台轉向緯創、廣達、和碩，廣達在宏碁出貨比重預估由不到兩成提高至三至四成。工商時報 2014 年 10 月 2 日報導：宏碁調整釋單結構，預估 2015 年廣達、緯創出貨成長、仁寶對宏碁出貨減少；「2014 年廣達與仁寶各約四成」之具體比例未獲證實。2018 年以後未見公開之量化分配比例，僅 DIGITIMES（約 2023–24 年）定性描述宏碁主要代工廠為廣達與仁寶。
ve: Acer's notebook ODM split appears only in press reports with differing scopes. Commercial Times (工商時報, 28 Jul 2009): in Acer's first-phase release of ~20 million notebook orders, Compal was the largest winner with over 30% (up to 35%), Quanta and Wistron each close to 30%, Inventec about 10%; no source was found for "Compal ~45%, Wistron 26–28%". Commercial Times (26 Jul 2012): Acer's reliance on Compal had fallen to 40–45%; ~5 million units were cut and shifted to Wistron, Quanta and Pegatron, with Quanta's share of Acer shipments expected to rise from under 20% to 30–40%. Commercial Times (2 Oct 2014): Acer restructured its order allocation, with Quanta and Wistron expected to grow and Compal's Acer shipments to fall in 2015; the specific "~40% each for Quanta and Compal in 2014" figure was not confirmed. No quantitative public breakdown after 2018 was found; DIGITIMES (c. 2023–24) only qualitatively names Quanta and Compal as Acer's main ODMs.
nz: 2009 年數字衝突：現有來源（U3/U4）稱 2009 上半年仁寶約 45%、緯創 26–28%；工商時報 2009-07-28 報導（第一階段 2,000 萬台釋單）為仁寶逾三成（可達 35%）、廣達與緯創各近三成、英業達約一成，口徑可能不同（釋單量 vs. 上半年實際出貨比重），兩者不能互相印證。2014 年「廣達、仁寶各約四成、緯創第三」未找到直接來源，僅有 2012 年（仁寶 40–45%）及 2014-10-02 工商時報「NB代工廠 明年接單兩好三壞」（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20141002700110-439901）之定性描述。2018 年後無量化公開比例；DIGITIMES「NB代工市場投入深水炸彈 廣達主帥親赴聯想搶單」（https://www.digitimes.com.tw/tech/dt/n/shwnws.asp?id=0000685071_ETV192T76IREJJ2UYPNU5，約 2023–24 年）僅稱宏碁代工為廣達、仁寶。CTIMES「宏碁首款低價NB代工訂單廣達拔得頭籌」依網址日期為 2002 年報導，與 2018 年後無關。限制：僅 3 次搜尋、僅依搜尋摘要未讀全文。
ne: 2009 figures conflict: the existing sources (U3/U4) give Compal ~45% and Wistron 26–28% for H1 2009; Commercial Times (28 Jul 2009), on Acer's first-phase 20M-unit order release, gives Compal >30% (up to 35%), Quanta and Wistron ~30% each, Inventec ~10%. Scopes may differ (order release vs. actual H1 shipment share), so they do not corroborate each other. The 2014 "Quanta and Compal ~40% each, Wistron third" split has no direct source; closest are the 2012 figure (Compal 40–45%) and the qualitative Commercial Times 2 Oct 2014 report "NB代工廠 明年接單兩好三壞" (https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20141002700110-439901). No quantitative post-2018 breakdown; DIGITIMES "NB代工市場投入深水炸彈 廣達主帥親赴聯想搶單" (https://www.digitimes.com.tw/tech/dt/n/shwnws.asp?id=0000685071_ETV192T76IREJJ2UYPNU5, c. 2023–24) only names Quanta and Compal as Acer's ODMs. The CTIMES "廣達拔得頭籌" article is dated 2002 by its URL and is irrelevant to post-2018. Limits: 3 searches only; evidence is from search snippets, full articles not read.

vz: 據 CTIMES 2002 年 6 月 21 日報導，宏碁將 2002 年 7、8 月推出的首款低價筆記型電腦代工訂單交由廣達承接，為雙方睽違 12 年再度合作；當時緯創仍為宏碁筆電主力代工廠、Aspire 系列由仁寶代工，宏碁並預估全年釋單量逾 40 萬台。另據 DIGITIMES 2017 年 2 月 10 日引述業界消息報導，廣達 2017 年獲配惠普 35% 的筆電訂單（2016 年為 32%），並同時為 Apple、Acer 與華碩最大的筆電 ODM；廣達 2016 年筆電出貨量為 4,040 萬台，年減 6.67%。
ve: According to a CTIMES report dated 21 June 2002, Acer awarded the ODM order for its first low-priced notebook (launched in July–August 2002) to Quanta, the two companies' first collaboration in 12 years; at the time Wistron remained Acer's main notebook ODM and Compal built the Aspire line, with Acer estimating full-year order volume of more than 400,000 units. Separately, DIGITIMES reported on 10 February 2017, citing industry sources, that Quanta had been allocated 35% of HP's 2017 notebook orders (up from 32% in 2016) and was also the largest notebook ODM for Apple, Acer and Asustek; Quanta shipped 40.4 million notebooks in 2016, down 6.67% year-on-year.
nz: 敘述的兩個部分各僅有一個來源：2002 年 6 月宏碁釋單廣達僅見於 CTIMES（2002-06-21）；2017 年「Apple、Acer、華碩最大筆電 ODM」僅見於 DIGITIMES（2017-02-10，引述未具名業界消息）。Display Daily 的文章為轉載同一篇 DIGITIMES 報導，不計為獨立來源。Taipei Times（2002-04-17）提供一致的背景：2002 年 4 月宏碁約 100 萬台筆電訂單由緯創與仁寶（30–35%）分擔，但未提及廣達。「40 萬台」為宏碁預估的釋單量，非已確認的廣達訂單數量。未發現相互矛盾的來源。
ne: Each half of the statement rests on a single source: the June 2002 Acer order to Quanta is confirmed only by CTIMES (2002-06-21); the 2017 "largest notebook ODM for Apple, Acer and Asus" claim only by DIGITIMES (2017-02-10, citing unnamed industry sources). Display Daily's article republishes the same DIGITIMES report and is not independent. Taipei Times (2002-04-17) gives consistent context, with Acer's roughly 1 million 2002 notebooks then split between Wistron and Compal (30–35%), but does not mention Quanta. The 400,000-unit figure is Acer's estimate, not a confirmed Quanta order quantity. No contradicting source was found.

nz: 兩個佐證來源均為 DIGITIMES 同一家媒體（2013 年該篇本身引述蘋果日報報導；兩篇皆需付費，僅能依預覽片段），且各自只支撐敘述的一部分（2009 年上半年比重；2013/2014 年排名），每一子敘述都只有單一來源，未達「兩個獨立來源」標準。未找到第二家獨立媒體或公司文件確認：工商時報 2014-10-02（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20141002700110-439901）僅提到宏碁調整釋單結構、仁寶對宏碁出貨預估減少（談 2015 年），未給出 2013/2014 年供應商排名；工商時報 2012-07-26（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20120726700061-439901）提到宏碁 2012 年砍仁寶約 500 萬台訂單轉向緯創、廣達、和碩，僅為背景。搜尋額度 3 次已用完。
ne: Both supporting sources are from the same outlet, DIGITIMES (the 2013 piece itself relays Apple Daily reporting; both articles are paywalled, so only preview snippets were available), and each supports only one part of the statement (H1 2009 share; 2013/2014 ranking), so every sub-claim rests on a single source and the two-independent-source bar is not met. Search budget of 3 exhausted.

en: Acer orders in 2006, 2008 and 2009; reportedly dropped for 2011.
vz: 宏碁於 2005 年底新增英業達為第四家筆電代工夥伴（首款合作機種為 19 吋筆電，CTIMES 2005 年 12 月報導）；2009 年 10 月宏碁曾召回五款由英業達代工的 13.3 吋機款（工商時報）。原述之 2008 年藍光筆電全部訂單、2009 年 CULV 訂單，以及 2010 年「宏碁 2011 年訂單排除英業達」之報導，本輪未重新查證。可確認的是，英業達至少在 2019 年至 2020 年初仍為宏碁供應商：英業達取得宏碁 Predator Helios 300 電競系列與 ConceptD 5/5 Pro 創作者系列的代工訂單（MoneyDJ），2020 年 2 月 5 日工商時報亦將宏碁與惠普、富士通並列為英業達既有品牌客戶（兩則報導均出自同一時期的英業達營運展望說明）。2011–2018 年及 2021 年迄今是否持續供應宏碁，均未見可靠公開來源證實；所見 2024–2025 年英業達筆電業務報導亦未提及宏碁。
ve: Acer added Inventec as its fourth notebook ODM partner at the end of 2005 (first model: a 19-inch notebook, per CTIMES, Dec 2005); in October 2009 Acer recalled five 13.3-inch models built by Inventec (Commercial Times). The earlier claims of all Acer Blu-ray notebook orders in 2008, Acer CULV orders in 2009, and a 2010 report that Acer would drop Inventec from its 2011 orders were not re-verified in this round. What can be confirmed is that Inventec was still an Acer supplier at least in 2019 to early 2020: it won ODM orders for Acer's Predator Helios 300 gaming and ConceptD 5/5 Pro creator notebooks (MoneyDJ), and a 5 February 2020 Commercial Times report listed Acer alongside HP and Fujitsu as existing Inventec brand customers (both reports stem from the same Inventec outlook briefing). No reliable public source confirms continuous supply during 2011–2018 or after 2020; the 2024–2025 coverage of Inventec's notebook business found does not mention Acer.
nz: 限制：(1) s1（工商時報 2020-02-05）與 s2（MoneyDJ，頁面日期未顯示）為不同媒體各自撰寫，但均報導同一場 2020 年初英業達營運展望（經濟日報亦有平行報導 https://money.udn.com/money/story/5612/4322624），共用同一原始來源，不構成兩個獨立佐證，故狀態降為 single。(2) s2 僅稱「去年」收穫頗多，「2019 年取得」為推論；s2 日期未能確定。(3) 2005 年第四家代工夥伴（CTIMES）與 2009 年召回（工商時報）各僅一個來源；2010 年排除報導、2006 年 Toshiba/Acer、2008 年藍光、2009 年 CULV 等細節本輪未查證，仍依原 U13–U16。(4) 無任何來源涵蓋 2011–2018 年，原 vz 之「其後仍持續供應」為過度推論。(5) 查核方另以 1 次搜尋（英業達 宏碁 筆電 代工 訂單 2024 2025）檢視 2024–2025 年報導（鉅亨網 https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/5425175、科技島 https://www.technice.com.tw/project/tech-frontline/164388/ 等），搜尋摘要均未提及宏碁訂單；低品質彙整頁（adreamertech、CMoney AI 問答）彼此不一致，不宜引用。(6) 補充獨立來源：CTIMES 2005-12 http://ctimes.com.tw/DispNews/tw/英華達/Inventec/筆記型電腦/英業達/宏碁/0512202351TT.shtml；工商時報 2009-10-14 https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20091014700071-439901；Digitimes 2005-03-23 https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20050323A4013.html。
ne: Limits: (1) s1 (Commercial Times 2020-02-05) and s2 (MoneyDJ, page date not shown) are separately written but both cover the same early-2020 Inventec outlook briefing (Economic Daily ran a parallel piece: https://money.udn.com/money/story/5612/4322624); they share one primary source and do not count as two independent confirmations, so status is lowered to single. (2) s2 only says "last year" was a good harvest; "won in 2019" is an inference, and s2's date is unconfirmed. (3) The 2005 fourth-ODM claim (CTIMES) and the 2009 recall (Commercial Times) each rest on a single source; the 2010 exclusion report, 2006 Toshiba/Acer, 2008 Blu-ray and 2009 CULV details were not verified this round and still rest on U13–U16. (4) No source covers 2011–2018, so the original vz's "continued to supply" overstated continuity. (5) The fact-checker's one search (英業達 宏碁 筆電 代工 訂單 2024 2025) surfaced 2024–2025 coverage (cnyes https://news.cnyes.com/news/id/5425175, Technice https://www.technice.com.tw/project/tech-frontline/164388/, etc.) whose summaries do not mention Acer orders; low-quality aggregator pages (adreamertech, CMoney AI answers) are mutually inconsistent and should not be cited. (6) Additional independent sources: CTIMES Dec 2005 http://ctimes.com.tw/DispNews/tw/英華達/Inventec/筆記型電腦/英業達/宏碁/0512202351TT.shtml; Commercial Times 2009-10-14 https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20091014700071-439901; Digitimes 2005-03-23 https://www.digitimes.com/news/a20050323A4013.html.

zh: 2010 年 8 月法說會列 2011 年筆電訂單含 Acer。
en: August 2010 investor conference listed 2011 notebook orders including Acer.
vz: 和碩聯合於 2010 年 8 月 19 日舉行上市後首場法說會；據《數位時代》2010 年 8 月 20 日報導，和碩分家後積極爭取非華碩客戶，其 2011 年出貨訂單除惠普桌機、Sony PS3 組裝及 Apple CDMA iPhone 外，另包括聯想、宏碁與華碩的筆電訂單；執行長程建中並預估分家效益自 2010 年第四季起至 2011 年逐步顯現。
ve: Pegatron held its first post-listing investor conference on 19 August 2010. According to a BusinessNext (數位時代) report dated 20 August 2010, Pegatron, actively seeking non-Asus customers after the spin-off, had 2011 shipment orders that included HP desktops, Sony PS3 assembly and the Apple CDMA iPhone, plus notebook orders from Lenovo, Acer and Asus; CEO Jason Cheng expected the spin-off benefits to show from Q4 2010 into 2011.
nz: 僅《數位時代》2010-08-20 一篇報導明確指出 2010-08-19 法說會所列 2011 年筆電訂單包括聯想、宏碁與華碩，故維持 single。DigiTimes 2010-08-20 報導僅佐證該場法說會及程建中「華碩筆電訂單量不會大幅減少」之說法，未提及聯想與宏碁；工商時報 2010-06-25（上市前）報導稱和碩同時爭取宏碁桌機與筆電訂單，但程建中未證實細節；工商時報 2010-10-28（第三季法說）僅稱明年預期 3 至 4 家一線品牌訂單開始出貨，未點名客戶。未找到和碩官方法說會簡報或第二個獨立來源證實完整敘述（特別是聯想部分）。3 次搜尋額度已用完。
ne: Only the BusinessNext (數位時代) report of 2010-08-20 explicitly ties 2011 notebook orders from Lenovo, Acer and Asus to the 2010-08-19 conference, so the status remains single. DigiTimes (2010-08-20) corroborates only the conference and CEO Jason Cheng's remark that Asustek notebook order volumes would not fall significantly; it does not mention Lenovo or Acer. CTEE/工商時報 (2010-06-25, pre-listing) says Pegatron was pursuing Acer desktop and notebook orders but the CEO declined to confirm details; CTEE (2010-10-28, Q3 conference) only says 3-4 tier-1 brand orders were expected to start shipping in 2011 without naming them. No official Pegatron presentation and no second independent source for the full statement (especially the Lenovo part) were found within the 3-search budget.

zh: 2003 年首批鴻海代工桌機；2006 年小型桌機；2010 年筆電試產訂單。
en: Foxconn-built desktops in 2003 and 2006; notebook test order in 2010.
vz: 2003年，宏碁在美國與中國市場銷售首批由鴻海代工組裝的桌上型電腦；2006年在台灣推出鴻海代工的小型桌機；2010年4月，鴻海取得宏碁筆記型電腦的小量試產訂單。另據公開報導，2009年11月工商時報引述宏碁董事長曾表示宏碁桌機交由鴻海代工，宏碁並於同月表態願意釋出筆電訂單予鴻海；2011年3月宏碁進一步擴大桌機委外予鴻海，當時宏碁系統產品的供應商為鴻海、精英、緯創與廣達四家。
ve: In 2003 Acer began selling its first Foxconn-assembled desktop PCs in the US and China; in 2006 it launched Foxconn-built small-form-factor desktops in Taiwan; and in April 2010 Foxconn received a small trial-production order for Acer notebooks. Separately, a Commercial Times report in November 2009 quoted Acer's chairman as having said that Acer's desktops were built by Foxconn, and Acer indicated that month that it was willing to place notebook orders with Foxconn; in March 2011 Acer further increased desktop outsourcing to Foxconn, at which time its four system suppliers were Foxconn, ECS, Wistron and Quanta.
nz: 原敘述之三項具體時點（2003年美、中首批鴻海代工桌機、2006年台灣鴻海代工小型桌機、2010年4月鴻海取得宏碁筆電小量試產訂單）仍僅有既有單一來源U22–U25；研究者三次搜尋及本次複核一次搜尋（針對2010年4月筆電試單）均未找到獨立公開來源，但亦無來源與之矛盾，故維持 single。s1（工商時報2009-11-27）與s2（DIGITIMES 2011-03-14）為不同媒體、不同日期、不同事件，屬獨立來源，但兩者僅佐證鴻海為宏碁桌機代工廠、宏碁2009年11月願釋筆電訂單予鴻海、2011年3月擴大桌機委外等較寬泛事實，不涉及原敘述之年份；Softpedia係轉載DIGITIMES，不另計。注意：s1引文來自搜尋摘要而非原文，且僅稱董事長「曾表示」，不宜寫成「2009年11月公開證實」；s2明示宏碁系統產品有四家供應商，故不宜稱鴻海為「主要」代工廠。研究者原vz/ve將研究備註寫入敘述本文，已移除；搜尋摘要提及之2005年工商時報Aspire桌機報導無可引用網址，未採用。
ne: The three dated milestones in the original statement (first Foxconn-built desktops sold in the US and China in 2003; Foxconn-built small desktops in Taiwan in 2006; a small trial-production notebook order in April 2010) remain supported only by the existing single source U22–U25. The researcher's three searches and one further check in this review (targeting the April 2010 notebook trial order) found no independent public source, but also nothing contradicting them, so the status stays "single". s1 (Commercial Times, 2009-11-27) and s2 (DIGITIMES, 2011-03-14) are different outlets, dates and events and therefore independent, but they corroborate only the broader relationship (Foxconn assembles Acer desktops; Acer willing to place notebook orders with Foxconn in Nov 2009; Acer increased desktop outsourcing in Mar 2011) and do not address the years in the statement; Softpedia republishes DIGITIMES and is not counted separately. Caveats: the s1 quote comes from a search snippet rather than the article text and only says the chairman "had said" desktops were made by Foxconn, so it should not be rendered as a "November 2009 public confirmation"; s2 lists four Acer system suppliers, so Foxconn should not be called Acer's "principal" assembler. The researcher's vz/ve embedded research notes in the statement body; these have been removed. The 2005 Commercial Times Aspire desktop report mentioned in a search summary had no citable URL and was not used.

s1.t: 宏碁NB找鴻海代工

s2.t: Acer stepping up outsourcing of desktop PCs to Foxconn

en: HSN is Acer's official service provider in Malaysia with 16 Acer customer service centres.
vz: 海柏特馬來西亞子公司 Highpoint Service Network Sdn Bhd 為 Acer 馬來西亞官方服務商（Acer's Official Service Provider）；依 Acer 馬來西亞官網服務據點頁所列，其 Acer 服務中心共 16 處（含 Subang Jaya 總部），分布於吉隆坡、Subang Jaya、檳城、怡保、新山、居鑾、馬六甲、芙蓉、關丹、哥打峇魯、亞庇、斗湖、山打根、古晉、美里、詩巫。
ve: Highpoint Service Network Sdn Bhd, the Malaysian subsidiary of Highpoint, is Acer Malaysia's official service provider; according to Acer Malaysia's official service-centre locator, it operates 16 Acer service centres (including the Subang Jaya HQ) in Kuala Lumpur, Subang Jaya, Penang, Ipoh, Johor Bahru, Kluang, Melaka, Seremban, Kuantan, Kota Bharu, Kota Kinabalu, Tawau, Sandakan, Kuching, Miri and Sibu.
nz: 「官方服務商」身分有 Acer 馬來西亞官網（s1）與 HSN 官網（s2）兩個獨立來源確認。但「16 處」僅見於 Acer 官網服務據點頁（含同站 contacts 頁，均屬同一發布者），HSN 官網 Authorized Service Provider 頁僅列出 14 處筆電維修據點（未列斗湖、山打根）且未標明品牌，故據點數無第二獨立來源，整體狀態應為 single 而非 verified。所引 q 為搜尋引擎摘要非逐字原文；Acer 頁面無日期，據點數可能隨時變動，網站文案宜註明「依 Acer 馬來西亞官網所列」。
ne: HSN's status as Acer Malaysia's official service provider is confirmed by two independent publishers (acer.com/my-en and hsnservice.com). The "16 centres" count, however, appears only on Acer's own site (the locator page and the same-site contacts page are one publisher); HSN's Authorized Service Provider page lists just 14 distinct laptop-repair locations (Tawau and Sandakan absent) with no brand attribution, so the count has no independent second source and the statement as a whole should be rated "single", not "verified". Quoted q text is search-engine paraphrase, not verbatim page text; Acer's page is undated and the count can change, so the site copy should attribute the figure to Acer Malaysia's official locator.

vz: Acer 菲律賓官方支援頁面（未標示日期）將 Highpoint Services Network Philippines（HSN Philippines）列為 Master ASP（授權服務商），服務中心位於 1172-1180 President Quirino Avenue Extension, Paco, Manila，營業時間週一至週六 08:30–17:30。HSN 官網亦列出同一地址之菲律賓服務中心，並稱 Acer 為其母品牌，但未使用「Master ASP」一詞。
ve: Acer Philippines' official (undated) support page lists Highpoint Services Network Philippines (HSN Philippines) as its Master ASP (authorized service provider), with the service centre at 1172-1180 President Quirino Avenue Extension, Paco, Manila, open Mon–Sat 08:30–17:30. HSN's own website lists a Philippine service centre at the same address and describes Acer as its parent brand, but does not use the term "Master ASP".
nz: 限制：「Master ASP」此一等級名稱僅見於 Acer 菲律賓官方支援頁面（未標示日期），屬單一來源。s2（hsnservice.com/ph/service_center）為搜尋引擎摘要而非直接擷取之頁面內容，且 HSN 為 Acer 旗下服務子公司／官方服務供應商（Acer 馬來西亞頁面 https://www.acer.com/my-en/support/service-network/highpoint-service-network 稱「HSN is Acer's official Service Provider ... established in 1999 in Malaysia; In 2018 HSN expanded ... Indonesia, Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand and VietNam」；DIGITIMES 2026-07-10 報導 HSN 為 Acer 子公司，付費牆），故 s1 與 s2 非獨立來源，僅能佐證服務中心存在，不能佐證「Master ASP」等級。Acer Store PH 聯絡頁（https://store.acer.com/en-ph/contact/）列出相同地址與電話，但同屬 Acer，亦非獨立來源。聯絡電話各來源不一致（Acer 頁 (02) 8-555-2300、HSN 官網 +63 955 380 0450、HSN 社群貼文 (02) 8672-1051），故正文不列電話；舊版 serviceph.acer.com 列有另一地址 1651 Paz Guazon St., Paco, Manila，疑已過時。HSN 成立年份、2018 年擴展及子公司身分等資訊未見於 s1/s2，故自正文移除並留於備註。
ne: Limit: the "Master ASP" tier label appears only on Acer Philippines' official (undated) support page, i.e. a single source. s2 (hsnservice.com/ph/service_center) is a search-engine summary rather than fetched page text, and HSN is Acer's own service subsidiary/official service provider (Acer Malaysia's page https://www.acer.com/my-en/support/service-network/highpoint-service-network states "HSN is Acer's official Service Provider ... established in 1999 in Malaysia; In 2018 HSN expanded ... Indonesia, Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand and VietNam"; DIGITIMES, 2026-07-10, reports HSN as an Acer subsidiary, paywalled), so s1 and s2 are not independent and s2 corroborates only the existence of the service centre, not the "Master ASP" tier. The Acer Store PH contact page (https://store.acer.com/en-ph/contact/) repeats the same address and phone but is also Acer-owned, so not independent. Phone numbers conflict across sources (Acer page (02) 8-555-2300, HSN site +63 955 380 0450, HSN social post (02) 8672-1051), so no phone is given in the statement; the older serviceph.acer.com page lists a different address, 1651 Paz Guazon St., Paco, Manila, likely outdated. HSN's founding year, 2018 expansion and subsidiary status are not in s1/s2 and have been moved out of the statement into these notes.

zh: 泰國為 Acer 中南半島備品中心，週轉由 17–20 天縮至 3 天。
en: Thailand is Acer's Indochina parts hub; turnaround cut from 17–20 days to 3.
vz: 2016 年 2 月，Acer Computer (Thailand) 宣布以泰國作為中南半島（Indochina）的物流暨備品中心，以把握區域成長及東協經濟共同體（AEC）商機；Acer 泰國表示，此舉可將該地區的售後服務週轉時間由 17–20 天縮短至約 3 天。Acer 泰國並投資 5,000 萬泰銖升級客服系統、服務中心與備品物流中心。
ve: In February 2016 Acer Computer (Thailand) announced it would use Thailand as its logistics and spare-parts hub for Indochina to capitalise on regional growth and the ASEAN Economic Community; Acer Thailand said the move would cut after-sales service turnaround in the region from 17–20 days to about three days. Acer Thailand also invested Bt50 million to upgrade its customer-service system, service centres and spare-parts logistics hub.
nz: 「泰國作為中南半島備品中心」由 Bangkok Post（2016-02-08）明確報導；The Nation 為獨立泰國媒體，另報導 Acer 泰國投資 5,000 萬泰銖升級備品物流中心，但其摘要未提及中南半島範圍。研究者稱「17–20 天縮短至 3 天」無來源佐證、僅依賴 V5 之說有誤：該數字即出自 s1 Bangkok Post 全文（Acer 泰國表示此舉「將」把區域售後服務時間由 17–20 天縮短至約 3 天，屬宣布時的預期效果而非事後實績）。惟此數字僅 Bangkok Post 一家報導，The Nation 摘要未載，故整句維持 single；敘述宜以「Acer 泰國表示」加以限定，並採「約 3 天」。Irrawaddy 相關報導係轉引 Bangkok Post，不構成獨立來源。
ne: The Indochina hub claim is explicitly reported by the Bangkok Post (8 Feb 2016). The Nation is an independent Thai outlet that separately reports the Bt50 million investment and spare-parts logistics hub upgrade, but its snippet does not mention the Indochina scope. The researcher's assertion that the 17–20-day to 3-day figure is uncorroborated and rests only on 'V5' is wrong: the figure comes from the full text of s1 itself (Bangkok Post), where Acer Thailand says the hub 'would' cut regional after-sales service times from 17–20 days to about three days — a stated expectation at announcement, not a measured result. Because only one outlet reports the figure (absent from The Nation snippet), the full statement remains single; attribute the figure to Acer Thailand and use 'about three days'. An Irrawaddy item cites the Bangkok Post and is not an independent source.

s1.t: Acer to use Thailand as parts hub for Indochina

zh: HSNT Rama 3 服務中心 2025 年 9 月整修啟用。
en: HSNT's Rama 3 centre reopened in September 2025.
vz: 宏碁泰國（Acer Computer (Thailand)）於 2025 年 9 月 11 日發布新聞稿，宣布海柏特泰國公司（Highpoint Service Network Thailand, HSNT）曼谷 Rama 3 服務中心完成大規模整修並以新貌啟用，擴大服務空間並升級設施，以提升售後服務標準。HSNT 於 2018 年以 Acer 集團旗下新創公司形式成立。
ve: On 11 September 2025, Acer Computer (Thailand) announced by press release the unveiling of the renovated Highpoint Service Network Thailand (HSNT) Rama 3 service centre in Bangkok, following a major refurbishment that enlarged the service area and upgraded facilities to raise after-sales service standards. HSNT was founded in 2018 as a start-up under the Acer Group.
nz: 來源非獨立：s1（Thai Post, 2025-09-12）與 s2（Telecomlover, 2025-09-11）以及 MGR Online、Brickinfo、Notebookspec 皆改寫自宏碁泰國 2025 年 9 月 11 日同一份新聞稿（ThaiPR.net：https://www.thaipr.net/business/3642235），研究者亦自述「非獨立採訪」，故不符合「兩個獨立來源一致」的 verified 條件，降為 single。事件內容（Rama 3 服務中心整修後新貌發表、場地擴大與設備升級、HSNT 於 2018 年成立）由新聞稿及各轉載一致支持，無數值衝突。限制：Thai Post 摘要僅示「12 ก.ย.」未含年份，2025 年由 Telecomlover 網址日期推定；來源僅載明發表／揭幕日（9 月 11–12 日），未載明整修後正式恢復營業日期；Nanglinchi Road 地址出自 Acer 官方服務中心 PDF，非 s1/s2 內容，已自主文移除。
ne: Sources are not independent: s1 (Thai Post, 2025-09-12), s2 (Telecomlover, 2025-09-11) and the other outlets cited (MGR Online, Brickinfo, Notebookspec) all rewrite the same Acer Thailand press release of 11 Sept 2025 (ThaiPR.net: https://www.thaipr.net/business/3642235), as the researcher concedes ("did not report independently"). This fails the "two independent sources that agree" test for verified, so the status is lowered to single. The substance (unveiling of the renovated Rama 3 centre, larger site and upgraded facilities, HSNT founded 2018 as an Acer Group start-up) is consistently supported by the release and its reprints; no conflicting figures. Limits: the Thai Post snippet shows "12 ก.ย." without a year, so 2025 is inferred from Telecomlover's URL date; the sources give the announcement/unveiling date (11–12 Sept), not a documented first day of resumed operations; the Nanglinchi Road address comes from Acer's official service-centre PDF rather than s1/s2 and has been dropped from the main text.

zh: 海柏特越南公司 2020 年 12 月設立。
en: HSN Vietnam set up December 2020.
vz: 海柏特越南公司（Highpoint Service Network Vietnam Company Limited；越南登記名稱 CÔNG TY TNHH HIGHPOINT SERVICE NETWORK VIỆT NAM，稅籍編號 0316638575，由胡志明市稅務機關管轄之外資有限責任公司）依越南稅籍登記資料於 2020 年 12 月 14 日開始營運，與「2020 年 12 月設立」之敘述相符。
ve: According to Vietnamese tax-registry data, Highpoint Service Network Vietnam Company Limited (registered as CÔNG TY TNHH HIGHPOINT SERVICE NETWORK VIỆT NAM, tax code 0316638575, a foreign-invested LLC administered by the Ho Chi Minh City tax authority) commenced operations on 14 December 2020, consistent with the statement that it was set up in December 2020.
nz: 本次搜尋結果中僅 chogia.vn（越南稅籍查詢網，轉載稅務總局登記資料）之摘要明確載有營運起始日（ngày hoạt động）2020-12-14；thuvienphapluat.vn 與 dauthau.net 僅確認公司名稱、稅籍編號 0316638575、胡志明市登記地址（585, 587 Điện Biên Phủ）及章程資本 3,459,000,000 越南盾，摘要未顯示日期。各越南稅籍查詢網站皆轉載同一政府登記資料，依規則只能計為一個來源，故本次自身結果僅能報 single。若現有來源 V4 為海柏特自身文件（公開說明書／年報／公開資訊觀測站申報），則 V4 加上越南稅籍登記已構成兩個獨立來源，可升為 verified。另：河內分公司（0316638575-001）營運起始日為 2022-03-25。中文（海柏特 越南 子公司 設立）與英文搜尋均未出現載明設立日期之台灣報導或公司頁面；2022 年報導僅提及海柏特已於馬來西亞、泰國、菲律賓、印尼及越南成立子公司。
ne: Only chogia.vn (a Vietnamese tax-code lookup site mirroring the General Department of Taxation registry) explicitly gives the operation start date 14/12/2020 in the search results; thuvienphapluat.vn and dauthau.net confirm the entity name, tax code 0316638575, HCMC registered address (585, 587 Dien Bien Phu) and charter capital VND 3,459,000,000, but their snippets show no date. All Vietnamese tax-lookup sites republish the same government registry record, so they count as one source, hence "single" from this run's own results. If the existing source V4 is an HSN document (prospectus, annual report or MOPS filing), V4 plus the Vietnamese registry record would make two independent sources and the item could be upgraded to verified. Extra detail: the Hanoi branch (0316638575-001) started operating on 25/03/2022. Neither the Chinese nor the English search surfaced a Taiwanese news article or company page stating the founding date; 2022 reports only state that HSN has subsidiaries in Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia and Vietnam.

zh: F1 Info Solutions 為 Acer 授權服務夥伴。
en: F1 Info Solutions is an authorised Acer service partner.
vz: F1 Info Solutions & Services Pvt. Ltd.（成立於 2012 年；Flipkart 於 2017 年 9 月收購並當時歸入其售後服務子公司 Jeeves，其後 F1 以獨立品牌專營品牌授權之手機與電子產品維修，Flipkart 表示所有權與業務結構不變）為 Acer 印度的授權服務夥伴。Acer 印度官方支援網絡（apn.acer.co.in）之泰米爾納德邦列表將「F1 Infosolutions & Services Pvt. Ltd.」列為服務夥伴（含清奈 Kilpauk 據點），服務範圍涵蓋桌上型電腦、伺服器、獨立 TFT 顯示器、投影機與筆記型電腦；F1 官方網站亦載明其透過 Authorized Acer Service Center 網絡提供 Acer 筆電維修（螢幕/電池更換、保固維修），合格維修享 90 天維修保固。
ve: F1 Info Solutions & Services Pvt. Ltd. (founded 2012; acquired by Flipkart in September 2017 and at that time placed under its after-sales subsidiary Jeeves; F1 has since operated under its own brand focused on brand-authorised mobile and electronics repair, with Flipkart stating that ownership and business structure were unchanged) is an authorised Acer service partner in India. The Tamil Nadu listing on Acer India's official Support Network (apn.acer.co.in) names "F1 Infosolutions & Services Pvt. Ltd." as a service partner (including a Kilpauk, Chennai branch) covering desktops, servers, standalone TFT monitors, projectors and notebooks; F1's own website states it repairs supported Acer laptops through an Authorized Acer Service Center network (screen/battery replacement, warranty repair) with a 90-day repair warranty on eligible repairs.
nz: 限制而非衝突：(1) Acer 官方列表僅見於州別頁面（泰米爾納德邦），未標示更新日期，可能有過時風險；Arumbakkam 分點的聯絡 email 為 cmsitservices.com 網域（CMS IT Services 為另一家 Acer 服務商），故已自陳述中移除，僅保留附 F1 聯絡方式的 Kilpauk 據點。(2) 2017 年收購報導（NCN Online, https://www.ncnonline.net/flipkart-acquires-f1-info-solutions/）所列 F1 品牌夥伴為 Apple、Samsung、HP、Lenovo、Sony、Asus，未提及 Acer，Acer 合作應為其後建立或當時未被報導。(3) Flipkart 所有權由兩家獨立來源佐證：Business Standard/ANI（2017 年 9 月）https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ani/flipkart-acquires-f1-info-solutions-appoints-shammi-moza-as-senior-director-117092600915_1.html 及 Entrackr（2017 年 9 月）https://entrackr.com/2017/09/flipkart-buys-f1-info-solutions/。(4) 其後 Flipkart 為 F1 推出新品牌識別，將 F1（品牌授權手機/電子產品維修）與 Jeeves（大型家電、家具到府安裝維修）分開，並表示不影響兩者的業務結構或所有權：Indian Retailer https://indianretailer.com/news/flipkarts-f1-info-solutions-unveils-new-brand-identity-reinforces-focus-speed-and-customer（日期未能確認）；Flipkart Stories https://stories.flipkart.com/jeeves-f1-customer-first/。(5) 查核時無法重新開啟 s1、s2 及上述改版報導（代理伺服器拒絕連線），引文及 f1infoservices.com 為 F1 官方網站之認定均依研究者回報採信。inrdeals.com 目錄頁為非官方來源，未採用。
ne: Limits, not conflicts: (1) The Acer official listing was seen only on a state-level page (Tamil Nadu) with no last-updated date, so staleness is possible; the Arumbakkam entry uses a cmsitservices.com email (CMS IT Services is a separate Acer service provider), so it was removed from the statement and only the Kilpauk branch, which carries an F1 contact, is kept. (2) 2017 acquisition coverage (NCN Online, https://www.ncnonline.net/flipkart-acquires-f1-info-solutions/) named F1's brand partners as Apple, Samsung, HP, Lenovo, Sony and Asus without Acer, so the Acer relationship was either established later or not reported then. (3) Flipkart ownership is supported by two independent outlets: Business Standard/ANI (September 2017) https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ani/flipkart-acquires-f1-info-solutions-appoints-shammi-moza-as-senior-director-117092600915_1.html and Entrackr (September 2017) https://entrackr.com/2017/09/flipkart-buys-f1-info-solutions/. (4) Flipkart later gave F1 a new brand identity, separating F1 (brand-authorised mobile/electronics repair) from Jeeves (doorstep installation and repair of large appliances and furniture) and stating this does not affect the business structure or ownership of either: Indian Retailer https://indianretailer.com/news/flipkarts-f1-info-solutions-unveils-new-brand-identity-reinforces-focus-speed-and-customer (date not confirmed); Flipkart Stories https://stories.flipkart.com/jeeves-f1-customer-first/. (5) The fact-check could not re-open s1, s2 or the rebrand article (proxy refused the connections), so the quoted snippets and the identification of f1infoservices.com as F1's official site are accepted as reported. The inrdeals.com directory page is unofficial and was not used.

s2.t: Authorized Acer Service Center - F1 Services

zh: Acer 亞太備品第三方物流商。
en: Third-party logistics provider for Acer Asia Pacific spare parts.
vz: 經 3 次網路搜尋（英文 2 次、中文 1 次）及查核者 1 次補充搜尋，公開網路資料中均未找到指名 Acer 亞太區備品（spare parts）第三方物流商（3PL）的來源。僅見泰國媒體報導宏碁泰國子公司 Acer Computer (Thailand) 的備品物流樞紐：《Bangkok Post》報導宏碁將以泰國作為中南半島（Indochina）的物流與備品樞紐；《The Nation》報導宏碁泰國投資 5,000 萬泰銖升級服務基礎設施，備品物流樞紐由 1,000 平方公尺擴大至 3,000 平方公尺。上述內容僅依搜尋結果摘要（非原文）整理，兩篇報導的刊出日期未經確認；摘要中均未提及任何物流業者，亦無法據以判斷該樞紐係宏碁自營或委外經營。宏碁年報／永續報告及物流業者新聞室尚未查閱。本項目維持「查無資料」。
ve: Three web searches by the researcher (two English, one Chinese) plus one verification search found no public web source naming the third-party logistics provider (3PL) for Acer's Asia Pacific spare parts. The only related coverage is Thai press on the spare-parts logistics hub of Acer's Thai subsidiary, Acer Computer (Thailand): the Bangkok Post reported that Acer would use Thailand as its logistics and spare-parts hub for Indochina, and The Nation reported a Bt50 million service-infrastructure upgrade with the spare-parts logistics hub expanded from 1,000 to 3,000 square metres. These points are taken from search-result summaries, not the article text, and the publication dates are unconfirmed; neither summary names a logistics provider, and they do not establish whether the hub is operated in-house or outsourced. Acer annual/sustainability reports and 3PL newsrooms have not yet been examined. Status remains not found.
nz: 狀態「查無資料」正確，但原陳述有兩處超出來源：(1) 將泰國樞紐描述為「自建」，兩則搜尋摘要僅稱「宏碁的備品物流樞紐」，未說明自營或委外，不能排除由 3PL 代營；(2) 稱「宏碁官網、年報、物流業者新聞稿或案例研究均未揭露」，但研究者僅做 3 次網路搜尋，未實際查閱年報（其備註亦建議後續查年報），不應宣稱已排除這些管道。另：s1、s2 均為搜尋結果摘要而非原文，日期未確認；《The Nation》網址編號 30184524 屬 2012 年前後之舊文，摘要所稱「約五年半前」恐有誤（陳述未引用日期，不影響結論）。s1、s2 為不同媒體、不同事件，彼此獨立，但僅屬背景脈絡，不構成佐證。查核者補充搜尋（Acer spare parts logistics Asia Pacific 3PL）亦未找到指名業者：Logistics Insider 報導 Acer India 與第三方物流業者合作但未指名（https://www.logisticsinsider.in/logistics-as-a-business-differentiator-how-acer-india-is-building-a-futureready-supply-chain/）；宏碁泰國官網備品購買頁僅說明自家訂購流程（https://www.acer.com/th-th/support/service-network/service2）；波蘭 Asplex 為宏碁 EMEA 備品中心，非亞太。建議後續查宏碁年報／永續報告售後服務章節、內部採購合約，或 DHL、Kerry Logistics、Yusen、CEVA 等業者新聞室。使用者附帶訊息「這裡要更美麗」屬網頁呈現意見，與本查證步驟無關。
ne: Status notfound is correct, but the original statement went beyond the sources in two places: (1) it called the Thai hub "in-house/self-built", while both search summaries only say "its spare-parts logistics hub" and do not say whether it is operated in-house or outsourced, so 3PL operation cannot be ruled out; (2) it claimed Acer corporate pages, annual reports and 3PL press releases/case studies disclose nothing, but the researcher ran only three web searches and did not actually check annual reports (the researcher's own notes recommend doing so later), so those channels should not be asserted as exhausted. Also: s1 and s2 are search-result summaries, not article text, with unconfirmed dates; The Nation's article ID 30184524 points to a circa-2012 item, so the "about five and a half years old" estimate is doubtful (no date is asserted in the statement, so the conclusion is unaffected). s1 and s2 are different outlets reporting different events, hence independent, but they are background only and do not count as confirmation. The checker's one verification search (Acer spare parts logistics Asia Pacific 3PL) also found no named provider: a Logistics Insider piece says Acer India partners with 3PLs without naming any (https://www.logisticsinsider.in/logistics-as-a-business-differentiator-how-acer-india-is-building-a-futureready-supply-chain/); Acer Thailand's spare-parts purchase page describes only its own ordering process (https://www.acer.com/th-th/support/service-network/service2); Asplex (Poland) is Acer's EMEA spare-parts centre, not APAC. Suggested next steps: Acer annual/sustainability reports (after-sales sections), internal procurement contracts, or newsrooms of DHL, Kerry Logistics, Yusen, CEVA etc. The user's relayed remark "這裡要更美麗" concerns page presentation and is unrelated to this fact-check step.

s1.d: date not shown in snippet (search summary described the article as roughly 10 years old)

s2.t: Acer banks on growth in service revenue
s2.d: date not shown in snippet (search summary described the article as roughly five and a half years old)

zh: 其後於菲律賓、泰國、印尼、越南設立子公司；越南公司 2020 年 12 月設立。
en: Subsidiaries followed in the Philippines, Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam; Vietnam set up December 2020.
vz: 海柏特股份有限公司（Highpoint Service Network Corp.）於 2018 年在台灣設立；集團旗下另於馬來西亞（1999 年設立，為集團最早之服務據點）、菲律賓（2018 年）、泰國（2018 年）、印尼及越南設有子公司，其中越南子公司 Highpoint Service Network Vietnam Company Limited 於 2020 年 12 月 14 日取得執照並開始營運。
ve: Highpoint Service Network Corp. (HSN) was incorporated in Taiwan in 2018. The group also operates subsidiaries in Malaysia (established 1999, its earliest service entity), the Philippines (2018), Thailand (2018), Indonesia and Vietnam; the Vietnamese subsidiary, Highpoint Service Network Vietnam Company Limited, was licensed and commenced operations on 14 December 2020.
nz: (1) 原敘述「於台灣成立後，陸續於菲律賓…設立子公司」與官網時間表不符：菲律賓子公司於 2018 年 8 月設立，早於台灣公司（2018 年 9 月）；泰國為 2018 年 10 月。修正文已刪除先後順序之敘述，僅列各地設立年份。(2) 官網載菲律賓子公司由宏碁國際控股投資、馬來西亞子公司由宏碁股份有限公司投資，設立當時並非海柏特台灣公司直接設立，故改稱「集團旗下子公司」，並補列馬來西亞（1999 年）為集團最早據點。(3) 研究者 vz「為宏碁 100% 投資之子公司」為官網描述之設立時狀況；海柏特已於櫃買中心掛牌（6884），現行持股比例應以最新公開資訊為準，不宜以現在式陳述。(4) 月份層級日期（台 9 月、菲 8 月、泰 10 月）僅見於官網，屬單一來源，修正文僅採年份；越南 2020-12-14 由越南稅籍登記鏡像站（thuvienphapluat.vn 等四站計為一個來源）與 VietnamWorks 雇主頁面（本次查證確認其載明 2018 年擴展至印、菲、台、泰、越，越南公司 2020 年 12 月設立）相互獨立佐證；台灣 2018 年設立另有 FINDIT（統編 50872352）、Digitimes 佐證；馬來西亞 1999 年另有 Acer Malaysia 官方服務網頁佐證。(5) s1 與 s2 相互獨立但未涵蓋同一事實；「verified」係就修正後各分項之多來源佐證判定，原敘述之順序主張不成立。(6) 印尼子公司設立日期仍未查得。
ne: (1) The original wording "after its founding in Taiwan, HSN set up subsidiaries in the Philippines…" conflicts with the official timeline: the Philippines entity (Aug 2018) predates the Taiwan company (Sep 2018); Thailand followed in Oct 2018. The corrected text drops the sequencing claim and gives years only. (2) The official site states the Philippine entity was invested by Acer's international holding and the Malaysian entity by Acer Inc., so they were not set up by HSN Taiwan at the time; the text now says "group subsidiaries" and adds Malaysia (1999) as the group's earliest entity. (3) The researcher's "wholly owned Acer subsidiary" describes the position at founding per the official site; HSN is now TPEx-listed (6884), so current ownership should be taken from the latest disclosures and not stated in the present tense. (4) Month-level dates (TW Sep, PH Aug, TH Oct 2018) appear only on the official site (single source), so the corrected text uses years. The Vietnam date 14 Dec 2020 is corroborated by two independent sources: the Vietnamese tax-registry mirrors (thuvienphapluat.vn et al., counted as one) and the VietnamWorks employer page (verified in this check: expansion to Indonesia, Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam in 2018; Vietnam company established Dec 2020). The 2018 Taiwan founding is further supported by FINDIT (tax ID 50872352) and Digitimes; Malaysia 1999 by Acer Malaysia's official service page. (5) s1 and s2 are independent but cover different facts; "verified" applies to the corrected statement's components, not to the original sequencing claim, which fails. According to the company and media reports (TechNews, UAnalyze), it is Taiwan's first listed company whose main business is after-sales repair services; this "first in Taiwan" characterization is a company/media claim, not an official TPEx designation.
nz: 「台灣第一家」僅見於科技新報（搜尋片段，標題未確認）與優分析（僅標題，疑為中央社通稿轉載），兩者措辭均源自公司／櫃買中心掛牌典禮新聞稿，非獨立查證，故狀態降為 single。掛牌日 2025/12/17、承銷價 33 元、首日開盤 44 元另有工商時報（https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20251217700677-430201）、優分析（https://uanalyze.com.tw/articles/2212942399）及旺得富等多篇報導佐證。「宏碁集團旗下」未見於所引片段，惟為公開事實。
ne: The "first in Taiwan" claim appears only in TechNews (search snippet, title unconfirmed) and UAnalyze (headline only, likely syndicated CNA copy); both echo the company/TPEx listing-ceremony press-release wording and are not independent verification, so status is lowered to single. The Acer Group affiliation is not in the cited snippets but is public record.

vz: 依海柏特（HSN）於 2025 年 11 月 26 日上櫃前業績發表會之說明，其服務遍及台灣、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼、越南及菲律賓六個市場，服務據點逾 400 處，已取得近 50 個國際品牌之售後維修服務授權，可維修品項逾 100 種，涵蓋電腦、印表機、手機、零售設備（POS 機、掃碼機）、家電、遊戲主機、電子書閱讀器及數位樂器等。
ve: According to statements made by HSN (Highpoint Service Network) at its pre-listing results presentation on 26 November 2025, the company serves six markets (Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines) through more than 400 service points, holds after-sales repair authorisations from nearly 50 international brands and can repair more than 100 product types, including computers, printers, phones, retail equipment (POS terminals, scanners), home appliances, game consoles, e-readers and digital musical instruments.
nz: 狀態下修為 single：三項數字中僅「近 50 個品牌授權」同時見於科技新報（s1）與工商時報（s2）兩個獨立媒體；「逾 400 個據點」僅見於中時集團（工商時報 20251126700670 與旺得富 20251126900304／900469 屬同一集團，視為單一來源），「逾 100 種品項」僅見於科技新報。查核者另以一次搜尋確認旺得富 2025-11-26 報導確載「六國、逾 400 個據點、近 50 家國際品牌、授權維持率 9 成以上」，但 2025-12-17 上櫃掛牌當日之鉅亨網／優分析報導僅提及品項類別（智慧家電、數位樂器等），未見「100 種品項」之數字，故該數字仍為單一來源。其餘限制維持：(1) 所有數字皆為公司於 2025-11-26 業績發表會之自述，媒體未獨立查核；(2) s2 標題未經確認，引文係依搜尋摘要推定對應該 URL，引用前應開啟原文核對；(3) 海柏特已於 2025-12-17 以每股 33 元上櫃掛牌，網站若引用應註明數字時點為 2025 年 11 月。
ne: Status lowered to single: of the three figures, only "nearly 50 brand authorisations" appears in two independent outlets (TechNews, s1; Commercial Times/ctee, s2). "More than 400 service points" appears only in China Times group coverage (ctee 20251126700670 and wantrich 20251126900304/900469 are sister titles and count as one source), and "more than 100 product types" only in TechNews. The checker's single search confirmed the wantrich 2025-11-26 report carries "six countries, more than 400 sites, nearly 50 international brands, authorisation retention above 90%", but the 2025-12-17 listing-day coverage (cnyes/uanalyze) mentions product categories (smart appliances, digital instruments) without a product-type count, so that figure remains single-sourced. Remaining limits: (1) all figures are the company's own statements at its 2025-11-26 pre-listing presentation, not audited by the outlets; (2) s2's headline is unconfirmed and its quote was matched to the URL by inference from search summaries; open the article before citing; (3) HSN listed on the TPEx on 2025-12-17 at NT$33 per share; the website should date the figures to November 2025.

zh: Acer 區域代碼 AAP 之全稱。
en: The full name of Acer's region code AAP.
vz: AAP 應為 Acer Asia Pacific（宏碁亞太區營運總部）之縮寫，惟此為推論而非直接查證：所有檢得之公開來源均未出現「AAP」一詞。2007年美國SEC申報文件（Gateway Inc. Form SC 14D9）載明 Steve Lin 自2005年1月起擔任「Vice President of Acer and President of Acer Asia Pacific Regional Operation」，證實宏碁當時設有名為「Acer Asia Pacific Regional Operation」之區域單位。2014年起宏碁另設泛亞太營運總部（Pan Asia Pacific, PAP），涵蓋中國、台灣等市場；截至2022年，其總裁為侯知遠（Andrew Hou）。故教材中之 AAP 可能為2014年前之區域代碼，公開來源未載明此對應，以宏碁內部文件為準。
ve: AAP most plausibly stands for Acer Asia Pacific (Acer's Asia Pacific regional headquarters), but this is an inference rather than a directly verified fact: the string "AAP" appears in none of the retrieved public sources. A 2007 SEC filing (Gateway Inc. Form SC 14D9) records Steve Lin as "Vice President of Acer and President of Acer Asia Pacific Regional Operation since January 2005", confirming that Acer then had a regional unit by that name. From 2014 Acer set up Pan Asia Pacific (PAP) operations covering China, Taiwan and other markets; as of 2022 its president was Andrew Hou. "AAP" in the training material may therefore be a pre-2014 region code, no public source states the mapping; Acer's internal documents prevail.
nz: 兩個來源相互獨立，但所證事實不同：SEC 2007 文件僅證實2005年起存在「Acer Asia Pacific Regional Operation」單位；Inquirer 2022 僅證實2022年存在「Pan Asia Pacific (PAP)」單位。兩者及 DIGITIMES 2014、鉅亨網均未出現「AAP」縮寫；另以「Acer Asia Pacific」+「AAP」檢索亦無任何公開來源使用 AAP 作為宏碁區域代碼。因此「AAP = Acer Asia Pacific」為零來源直接支持之推論，依規則應標為 notfound，不宜標為 single。原文「現任總經理為侯知遠」以2022年報導推定2026年現況，缺乏依據，應改為「截至2022年」；「改以…名稱運作」暗示 AAP 更名為 PAP，但 DIGITIMES 2014 摘要僅稱 PAP 將涵蓋中國、台灣等市場，未提及更名。建議網站標示為「AAP：推定為 Acer Asia Pacific（亞太區；未經公開來源直接證實）」。
ne: The two sources are independent but attest different facts: the 2007 SEC filing only confirms a unit named "Acer Asia Pacific Regional Operation" existed from 2005; the 2022 Inquirer article only confirms a unit named "Pan Asia Pacific (PAP)" existed in 2022. Neither they, nor DIGITIMES 2014 or cnyes, contain the string "AAP"; an additional search for "Acer Asia Pacific" + "AAP" found no public source using AAP as an Acer region code. "AAP = Acer Asia Pacific" is therefore an inference with zero direct sources and should be marked notfound rather than single. The original text's "current president Andrew Hou" projects a 2022 report onto 2026 without support and should read "as of 2022"; "renamed/operated as PAP" implies AAP was renamed, whereas the DIGITIMES 2014 snippet only says PAP operations were to cover China, Taiwan and other markets. Recommend labelling the site entry as "AAP: presumed Acer Asia Pacific (Asia Pacific region; not directly confirmed by any public source)".

Additional corroboration: the FINDIT startup database entry is titled "Highpoint Service Network Corporation" (https://findit.org.tw/en/Startup/MVVlaEM2aGRZTkF2ejRLYm9wNExCQT09/Basic), and China Times Wantrich (https://wantrich.chinatimes.com/tw-market/listed/stock/6884) lists the English abbreviation HSNC. Caution: Highpoint Service Network Sdn Bhd (Malaysia, est. 1999, per Acer Malaysia's support page) and Highpoint Service Network Vietnam Company Limited are overseas affiliates, not the legal name of the Taiwan company. The statement as written ("Highpoint Service Network ...") is incomplete; the full name Highpoint Service Network Corporation should be used.
